svg.title: The denominator is strictly positive by the recovered shelter estimate. Its vacuum factor ev0 is the same one present in the numerator majorant, so cancellation leaves precisely the displayed extensive bill. All history choices entering τk are recorded scalar data; readout retains bgk, the band β ≤2 bβk, and the fixed stage constants. Consequently its monotonicity substitution and stagewise logarithmic bound recover with the same quantifier order and site factor |Λk|. Section recovery returns the original full-law mode integral and treasury estimate.
